segments.t: On a Paris street corner, Catherine Barneville is talking on the phone with Mathias when she suddenly suffers an accident. Panic ensues as Mathias scrambles to get emergency help. Let's listen to the scene in French first.
Oui Catherine, quel est ce rendez-vous?
Je t'attends à l'angle de la rue.
D'accord, j'arrive dans cinq minutes.
Attention, cette voiture roule trop vite!
Oh mon Dieu, je suis tombée!
Catherine, réponds-moi, que se passe-t-il?
Aidez-moi s'il vous plaît, j'ai mal!
Restez calme, ne bougez surtout pas!
Appelez vite les pompiers immédiatement!
Ma jambe me fait très mal.
Je cours te rejoindre, tiens bon!
Ils arrivent dans combien de temps?
Les secours arrivent dans quelques minutes.
Je suis là avec toi, Catherine.
Let's examine how Mathias and Catherine handle this street emergency step by step.
Oui Catherine, quel est ce rendez-vous?
'Yes Catherine, what is this appointment?' Mathias asks his wife about their planned meeting.
Je t'attends à l'angle de la rue.
'I am waiting for you on the street corner.' Catherine tells him where to find her.
D'accord, j'arrive dans cinq minutes.
'All right, I arrive in five minutes.' Mathias promises to meet her shortly.
Attention, cette voiture roule trop vite!
'Watch out, this car is driving too fast!' Catherine panics as a speeding vehicle approaches.
Oh mon Dieu, je suis tombée!
'Oh my God, I fell down!' Catherine cries out after slipping onto the sidewalk.
Catherine, réponds-moi, que se passe-t-il?
'Catherine, answer me, what is happening?' Mathias grows terrified hearing distress over the phone.
Aidez-moi s'il vous plaît, j'ai mal!
'Help me please, I am hurt!' Catherine pleads for assistance from passersby.
Restez calme, ne bougez surtout pas!
'Stay calm, above all do not move!' Mathias instructs her to remain still after the fall.
Appelez vite les pompiers immédiatement!
'Quickly call the fire department immediately!' Mathias urges bystanders to dial emergency services.
Ma jambe me fait très mal.
'My leg hurts me very much.' Catherine complains of severe leg pain.
Je cours te rejoindre, tiens bon!
'I run to join you, hold on!' Mathias dashes frantically across town toward her.
Ils arrivent dans combien de temps?
'In how much time do they arrive?' Catherine asks how long the ambulance will take.
Les secours arrivent dans quelques minutes.
'The rescue arrives in a few minutes.' Mathias reassures her that help is on the way.
Je suis là avec toi, Catherine.
'I am here with you, Catherine.' Mathias comforts his injured wife by her side. Now let's listen to the scene once more from start to finish.

A sudden accident throws Mathias into a panic as he rushes to Catherine's side while paramedics are called. Let's review the key expressions and vocabulary from this scene.
Je suis là avec toi, Catherine.
